== Related skills ==
* {{duplicate skill icon|Divine Healing|Heaven's Delight}}

==Hero Usage==
* Heroes use this skill without regard for its additional AoE healing to party members.

== Notes ==
* The earshot healing is granted to the caster's party members, rather than the target's (unlike [[Seed of Life]]).
* The target does not benefit from the additional party healing, however does benefit from Divine Favor.
* Skills that increase the healing of spells will increase the party healing beyond your Divine Favor bonus.
{{bug|Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing in earshot and not [[health gain]].}}

== Trivia ==
* The [[skill icon]] bears a resemblance to [[Energy Blast]] and the unimplemented skill [[Energy Font]].
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
